mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 70%+ of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5pp+ rise in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 5 years is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline, S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of cases over 5 years, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), rising inflation triggers aggressive Fed tightening expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods, S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC over 5 years < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO rises, S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC over 2 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 1.5% signals economic deceleration, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate falls below 1.5% in latest quarter
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth < 1.5%, S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3 years negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous slowdown in payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rise indicates labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises, S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of cases over 5 years, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, when HOUST declines, S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC over 5 years < 0.03.
